description: Read a field value from a SceneGraph node at runtime via RTA getValue. Returns the value as JSON. Pass either nodeId+field, or a full keyPath like "MainScene.rowList.0.title".

base.description: RTA base (default inferred from nodeId, or "scene" when using keyPath)

field.description: Field name on the node (used with nodeId)

host.description: IP address or hostname of the Roku device

keyPath.description: Full RTA keyPath instead of nodeId+field (e.g. "MainScene.rowList.focusedRow.title.text")

nodeId.description: uiElementId or scene id of the node (combined with `field`)

name: roku_get_value
